title: Release of Paid-Up Merchandise, Collection, Storage and Completion under Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements
content:
# Release, collection and storage of held merchandise

The merchandise held under an agreement of Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements is released to the customer once the balance reaches zero, and identification is checked before it is handed over. A piece leaves the stockroom only while the agreement stands at completed, forfeited or cancelled, and each piece leaves once. Someone other than the customer collects the merchandise only on the plans that allow third-party collection and only on written authority naming them. Paid-up merchandise left uncollected past the plan's holding period carries the plan's storage charge for each started month it stays in the stockroom. A protection plan may be added to the held piece before it is collected on the plans that admit it, and the protection desk writes it on its own terms from the day of collection. Loyalty points on a layaway sale are earned when the agreement is paid up rather than as the payments arrive, so a cancelled agreement leaves no points behind. A storage charge is booked to the agreement as its own entry under the storage fee code for each started month the paid-up merchandise stays in the stockroom.

## Questions answered

**When does a piece leave the stockroom?** Only while the agreement stands at completed, forfeited or cancelled on its record, and each piece leaves once; a piece under an agreement at opened, current, delinquent or on hold does not leave.

**Who may collect?** The customer, once identification has been checked. Someone else only where the plan allows third-party collection and only on written authority naming that person.

**What does storage cost?** Nothing for the plan's holding period after payoff. After that, the plan's storage charge for each started month, each month booked as its own storage entry. A piece collected within the holding period carries no storage; a piece collected on the first day past the holding period has started its first month past it and carries one month's charge; a piece still uncollected when a second month past the holding period has begun carries two.

**Can a protection plan be added?** Before collection, on the plans that admit it; it is written by the protection desk on that desk's own terms and runs from the day of collection.

**When are loyalty points earned?** When the agreement is paid up, not as each payment arrives. A cancelled agreement earns none.
